bio: Situated in the heart of the Collio vineyards, a beautiful landscape of rolling hills not far from the border with Slovenia, this restaurant serves traditional cuisine and wine from the region. The attractive relaxed dining rooms, along with the friendly family welcome, will make you feel immediately at home, so that you hardly notice the time passing. Meat takes centre stage on the menu, with a few vegetarian options featuring among the appetisers and first courses, with a focus on traditional flavours often with a modern twist....
